answer.text: Track benchmark indices (index funds) and trade on stock exchanges (ETFs)

explanation.text: The Logic: The source workbook describes index funds as funds that track benchmark indices and ETFs as instruments that trade on stock exchanges, with the performance chapter also referring to passive indexed strategies. That matches the keyed option. The Trap: Active management, guaranteed outperformance, and gold-only investing each contradict the passive / index-tracking definition supported in the source. Note: Only the index-tracking and exchange-traded characteristics are anchored to the cited pages; specific claims about low tracking error or low fees require a separately cited source.
